headline: Brazil to Resume Highway Concessions with R$ 31 Billion Investment Target
summary: Brazil is set to resume federal highway auction tenders in November, scheduling three concession disputes through December projected to unlock R$ 31 billion in infrastructure investments.
why: Toll road concessions are essential for modernizing Brazil's logistics corridors, boosting agribusiness transport efficiency and attracting private infrastructure capital.

impacts.name: Infrastructure & Logistics
impacts.why: R$ 31B in planned highway auctions provides concessionaires with extensive project pipelines.
